content: {"episode_id":"ep-05013","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 was ordered because the patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
